reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: Flash loan scam
reports.description:
Scammer advertises YT video of how to set up a working flash loan bot arbitrage or similar flash loan bots.
The deceptive video tricks non technical users that may want to learn about flash loans to follow step by step guide to create & deploy a fake flash loan contract in remix that would supposedly perform the swap. They ask them to "top up" the bot with min 0.5> BNB, recommending 1 BNB for optimal profit.
The contract deployed is based on a real flash loan contract with most lines commented out. The contract only has one payable function to send balance of wallet to the "swap address" that is actually just the scammer's address.
